description: Recent runs, newest first, optionally for one site, one monitor or one status. Each has the monitor (checkId, checkName, and its key in `journey`), status, trigger, timing and its error / warning; get_run has the detail. For older runs pass `before` (the startedAt of the last run you got).

before.description: Only runs started before this time (ISO 8601): the next page

siteId.description: Only runs for this site id

status.description: Only runs with this status (a failure the user resolved counts as passed)

name: list_runs
title: List runs
